source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 Insert -> handler_v2.insert() -> checkAndSetData() -> case DataType_VarChar: stores dataString without type validation
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 checkAndSetData() 函数在处理 VarChar 字段时，直接使用 fieldValue.String() 获取的字符串值(行 331)，然后在 case DataType_VarChar 分支(行 581-582)直接赋值，未检查原始 JSON 值类型。对于数字类型 JSON 值(如 12345)，gjson.String() 会返回其字符串表示'12345'，导致类型静默转换被接受，无验证错误抛出。

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API exhibits Type1_IllegalSuccess by accepting integer value (12345) for VARCHAR field text_field without type validation error. Contract milvus_type_entities_insert_001 explicitly requires 'data field types match collection schema'. Source code analysis confirms checkAndSetData() in utils.go converts any JSON value to string via fieldValue.String() then directly assigns to VarChar field without type checking. This is a genuine REST v2 type coercion bug matching the rest-v2-data-type-handling pattern where 'REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types'.
